name: RSLCOM Australia
summary: Australian arm of RSL Communications (RSL COM Australia Pty Ltd, from Oct 1996); fixed-line SME telco; acquired by Commander Communications in Mar 2003 ($59.9m). Distinct from RSL COM New Zealand (ACN 074 627 642).

events.details: Australian startup of RSL Communications Ltd: RSL Asia established RSL COM Australia Pty Limited in Oct 1996 (SEC filing). Servicing from Apr 1997; planned $400m ASX float (~2000) aborted after global parent bankruptcy 2001.

refs.label: SEC S-1: RSL Asia established RSL COM Australia, Oct 1996

events.details: Acquired by Commander Communications, announced 25 Mar 2003, $59.9m cash (some reports $72m incl. liabilities/earn-outs).
